A '''neuro-repulsor field generator''' was a device capable of damaging organic life. [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] [[Neuro-shock hand|Neuro-Shock Hand]] employed a neuro-repulsor field generator to deliver a [[neuro-shock]] to an opponent.
